class.name: IfcConstructionProductResourceType
class.brief_description: The resource type IfcConstructionProductType defines commonly shared information for occurrences of construction product resources. The set of shared information may include: common productivities common cost rates common properties within shared property sets It is used to define a construction product resource specification (i.e. the specific resource information that is common to all occurrence
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Defines types of construction product resources. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
